copy.kindsHead: How to handle each kind (where an annotation also has a comment, the conditions in the comment take precedence):
kind.see-comment.name: See comment
kind.see-comment.hint: Your comment says what to do
kind.see-comment.how: Act on the comment text. It may be a change request, a question or extra information; if it is a question, answer it in your reply first — the document does not always need to change.
kind.agree.name: Agree
kind.agree.hint: Fine as it is; no action needed
kind.agree.how: The reviewer agrees with this passage. Do not change it, and there is no need to report on it.
kind.explain-more.name: Explain more
kind.explain-more.hint: Too brief or unclear; expand it
kind.explain-more.how: This passage is too brief for readers to follow. Expand it in the document, explaining what it is, why, and how; explaining it only in your reply does not count as done.
kind.offer-alternatives.name: Offer alternatives
kind.offer-alternatives.hint: List options for you to pick; don't change it yet
kind.offer-alternatives.how: The reviewer does not want this decided yet. List 2–3 workable approaches with their trade-offs and ask the user to choose; do not change the document until the user has chosen.
kind.delete-text.name: Delete this text
kind.delete-text.how: Delete the quoted text (only the quote, not the whole paragraph), then adjust the surrounding sentences so the passage reads smoothly.
kind.rethink-first-principles.name: Rethink from first principles
kind.rethink-first-principles.hint: The premise may be wrong; reason it out again
kind.rethink-first-principles.how: The premise of this approach may be wrong. Go back to the problem it is meant to solve, reason it through again and report your conclusion; only if the conclusion differs from the current approach, rewrite the design and explain why.
kind.state-positively.name: State it positively
kind.state-positively.how: This passage lists what not to do ("no X, no Y"). Rewrite it to state what to do.
kind.drop-feature.name: Drop this feature
kind.drop-feature.how: This feature is dropped. Remove it from the document, and also from the other documents of the same change (for example the proposal, design and specs), deleting passages that exist only for it. Report where you removed it.
